hooks.name: Night Watch: PreToolUse (shell)
hooks.description: This repository ships its own Night Watch policy, so it is guarded whenever it is opened in Kiro. Asks before risky shell commands (curl piped to a shell, chmod 777, rm -rf) and blocks switching off TLS verification. Paths are relative to the repository root.

action.command: P=ghostkit/run.py; if [ -f "$P" ]; then python3 -I -S "$P" PreToolUse --policy apps/night-watch/ghostkit.toml --log .ghostkit/events.jsonl; fi

hooks.name: Night Watch: PostToolUse (shell)
hooks.description: Records how each shell command ended, so the graveyard report can tell an approval from a refusal.

action.command: P=ghostkit/run.py; if [ -f "$P" ]; then python3 -I -S "$P" PostToolUse --policy apps/night-watch/ghostkit.toml --log .ghostkit/events.jsonl || true; fi

hooks.name: Night Watch: Stop
hooks.description: Marks the end of an agent turn, which resolves any approval that was refused.

action.command: P=ghostkit/run.py; if [ -f "$P" ]; then python3 -I -S "$P" Stop --policy apps/night-watch/ghostkit.toml --log .ghostkit/events.jsonl || true; fi
